# k0rdent_cluster_type_version (Data Source)

One version of a ClusterType, as it was at that version.

The difference from `k0rdent_cluster_type` is that this reads a named version rather than the latest, and its `self_link` is version-scoped. A cluster created against that link stays on this version when a newer one is published; one created against the head link does not.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# One version of a ClusterType: its Kubernetes version, status and node pools.
data "k0rdent_cluster_type_version" "known_good" {
  cluster_type = "gpu-training"
  version_id   = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

# Warn if the version is no longer `available`, so it can't back a new
# cluster.
check "still_available" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.k0rdent_cluster_type_version.known_good.status == "available"
    error_message = "ClusterType version ${data.k0rdent_cluster_type_version.known_good.version} is ${data.k0rdent_cluster_type_version.known_good.status}, so it cannot back a new cluster."
  }
}

output "pool_ids" {
  value = [for p in data.k0rdent_cluster_type_version.known_good.node_pools : p.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_type` (String) The ClusterType's id, its slug in the region's catalog. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.
- `version_id` (String) UUID of the version to read, from `k0rdent_cluster_type_versions`. **Constraints:** Must be a ClusterType version id, which is a UUID.

### Optional

- `region` (String) Region to read. Defaults to the provider's `region`. **Constraints:** Must be lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter and not ending with a hyphen (`[a-z]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?`), because it becomes a segment of a request URL.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-form text describing it, for people to read, when one was set.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name, for display only.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) The k0s version this version provisions, as `vX.Y.Z`. Null for a ClusterType that is not Kubernetes-flavoured.
- `node_pools` (Attributes List) Node pools as they were defined at this version. Sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--node_pools))
- `self_link` (String) Version-scoped reference, for a cluster's `cluster_type`. This is the pinned form.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status of this version. A `deprecated` or `draft` version cannot back a new cluster, and this is the attribute to assert on before pinning to one.
- `version` (Number) Sequential version number, for display.

<a id="nestedatt--node_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `node_pools`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Optional display name.
- `id` (String) Pool slug. This is the key a cluster's or instance group's `node_pool` map uses.
- `machine_type` (String) Reference to the MachineType backing this pool. **Known gap.** A name only. A tenant can't read what hardware or image it is. The [hardcoded values](../guides/hardcoded-values.md) guide names the side that has to change.
- `node_count_default` (Number) Count used when a cluster does not override this pool. Null means a cluster must supply one.
- `node_count_max` (Number) Highest count this pool accepts. Null means unbounded.
- `node_count_min` (Number) Lowest count this pool accepts. Null means no floor above zero.
- `role` (String) `control-plane` or `worker`. Control-plane pools can't be scaled.

## Related

- [`k0rdent_cluster_type_versions`](../data-sources/cluster_type_versions.md) data source: lists every one.
- [`k0rdent_kubernetes_cluster`](../resources/kubernetes_cluster.md) resource: is pinned to a version by the version's `self_link`.
- [`k0rdent_cluster_type`](../data-sources/cluster_type.md) data source: reads the ClusterType at its newest version.
